source: World Health Organization (WHO) & International Diabetes Federation (IDF)
document_title: Definition and Diagnosis of Diabetes Mellitus and Intermediate Hyperglycaemia
section: Diagnostic Criteria for Diabetes Mellitus and Other Categories of Hyperglycaemia (Section 1)
guideline_statement: WHO diagnostic criteria classify intermediate hyperglycaemia into Impaired Fasting Glycaemia (IFG) and Impaired Glucose Tolerance (IGT). Both categories represent elevated metabolic risk states rather than diabetes disease state.
clinical_context: Clinical guidelines from WHO explicitly emphasize that statistical risk models and screening markers serve to identify candidates for confirmatory venous blood testing, not to deliver definitive clinical diagnosis.
